text: Portable Fire Extinguishers are regulated by the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) through its Bureau of Products Standards (BPS) PARTS: hose marking for hazard application c nozzle INSTRUCTIONS handle pressure gauge tank There are 4 types of fire extinguishers available in the coun- try.
